notes: Every bot now has a hidden skill that never changes: skilled bots climb the ladder, weak bots that get lucky still play weak
High-skill bots play like strong players: they fire strikes and pump out troops as fast as cooldowns allow
Matchmaking puts you against your own rank, some from one rank below and the odd one above
240 bots on the ladder, and the top 100 Champions get a numbered placement
Ranked: survive 20 minutes for +100 points; lose after 20 minutes and you lose nothing. Leaving still costs points
Ranked matches open with an animated RANKED intro and a your-team-vs-enemies screen with every player's rank
New ranked calling cards with your rank badge; Platinum, Diamond, Champion and Top 100 are fully animated
New profile frames around the outside of your card: Deep space, Electric, Wildfire, Missile barrage and Rank rain
